notes: expected = JSON of the results array as rendered by `render json:` (keys line_number, match_text, context[{line_number,content,is_match}], path, name, mtime). mtime is a Ruby Time serialized by ActiveSupport (TZ=UTC; ISO8601 with milliseconds). File mtimes pinned via File.utime ({content,mtime} or 1700000000-100*i in spec order). Query compiled as Regexp(query, IGNORECASE, timeout 0.5s); RegexpError -> Regexp.escape(query). Blank (ActiveSupport blank?, incl. NBSP) -> []. Lines = File#readlines(chomp: true).map(&:scrub) (\n and \r\n separators; lone \r is not a separator). Traversal stops once max_results reached (readdir order, unsorted), final sort by -mtime.to_i (Ruby sort_by; ties keep no guaranteed order).
